label: Policy test v1 — Stage 1 sourced draft: national peak-proxy reserve margin, reviewed capacity credits, build rates, explicit caps
policy_grade_reason: Draft set built on the narrow desk review, not a signed source register. The national peak factor has no coincident-peak source (1.25 is a dry-run midpoint of the reviewed 1.20-1.30 bound), provincial reserve standards were not extracted, and transmission/asymmetric interties, curtailment/timeslices, unit commitment, oil credits, and storage remain unresolved. policy_grade=false.

reserve_margin.note: RM_NATIONAL UDC (OSeMOSYS UDC1 is <=0), capacity-minus-required form: sum(-C2A*credit*TotalCapacityAnnual) + RM*peak_factor*1.11*sum(PWRTRN activity) <= 0. The 1.11 factor converts delivered PWRTRN activity to gross generation at the ELC<z>01 bus (model InputActivityRatio); without it the requirement is understated by about 10%. The 1.15 schedule is the Canadian national modelling convention from 2026, not a legal standard; provincial standards were not extracted and the single-region model cannot enforce them. peak_factor=1.25 is the dry-run midpoint of the reviewed 1.20-1.30 bound, not a national coincident peak. Annual peak proxy, not a loss-of-load calculation. Native RM3 is populated but non-authoritative.

capacity_credits.note: Nameplate de-rating for a national annual peak proxy; not ELCC. Wind 0.20 and solar 0.15 are national drafts anchored by IESO's MRI column (19.66% / 19.16%; the ELCC column is different) and Quebec wind (~15%). Gas 0.95 is anchored by IESO MRI 92.96%. Hydro 0.65, biomass 0.85, nuclear 0.90, coal 0.90, and geothermal 0.80 are drafts with no Canadian ELCC source. Oil is not separately credited; interties are 0 firm; storage/DR are not modelled.

build_rates.note: One central schedule inside the reviewed envelopes, not the envelope itself: wind 2.0-6.0 GW/yr (central 2.0/3.0/2.0), solar 0.2-1.0 GW/yr (central 0.2/0.5/0.2), gas 2.0 GW/yr from the +2.02 GW 2023-24 observed anchor, and nuclear 0.30 GW/yr from 2031 as a draft scenario (reviewed history is 0 net new build). PWRBIO 0.15 and PWRBCW 0.10 GW/yr are unsourced drafts; PWRBSW 0.15, hydro 0.25, and geothermal 0.10 are drafts. The value is per-zone, not a national envelope. No lead-time data: the model can build at cap in the same year.

tech_caps.note: Activity caps are inherited scenario/supply assumptions (20% wind, 5% PWRBIO, BC zonal BCW caps, cap_2021 hydro), not sourced policy. They are marked draft and are not policy-grade.

hydro.note: Hydro upper bounds are the canonical 2021 reference output. cap_2021 writes upper bounds only; no new hydro is forced. The 0.65 credit and 0.25 GW/yr build rate are drafts with no Canadian ELCC or lead-time source.

nuclear.note: Draft 0.30 GW/yr new-build rate after 2030 and a 30 GW total fleet cap. The reviewed history is about 0 net new nuclear in 2023-24; 0.30 is an optional scenario, not a sourced rate. The total cap is floored at ResidualCapacity per zone; it is an explicit draft bound, not a policy claim.

carbon.note: Carbon block is declared but not applied in Stage 1; the scenario EmissionsPenalty schedule remains the run-level carbon price. Null means not applied, not zero. No carbon-price or intensity-cap source was integrated.

sources.title: Policy data review — narrow source pass
sources.note: Desk review of public sources S1-S29 with URLs and confidence, not an archived or signed source register. Values are reviewed, not policy-grade.

notes: Sourced draft policy-test scaffold. policy_grade=false; do not describe results as policy-grade.
The value_status=draft / source_status=reviewed labels mean the narrow desk review in planning/policy-data-review.md was applied; they do not mean a signed source register exists.
Reserve margin is a national 15% modelling convention from 2026 (1.00 in 2021-2025). Provincial standards were not extracted and the single-region model cannot enforce them.
peak_factor=1.25 is the dry-run midpoint of the reviewed 1.20-1.30 bound. The former 1.55 is withdrawn; a national coincident peak is still missing.
The RM_NATIONAL activity term multiplies PWRTRN delivered activity by 1.11 to recover gross generation at the generation bus.
Wind 20%, PWRBIO 5%, BC zonal caps, hydro cap_2021, solar build-rate-only and nuclear build-rate mode are scenario/supply assumptions, not policy.
Structural gaps: transmission (single region, symmetric links, no network), curtailment/timeslices (one annual timeslice), unit commitment (LP only).

Remaining source gaps: no signed register/archived payloads; no national coincident peak or provincial demand; no Canadian ELCC for hydro/biomass/nuclear/oil; no storage/DR; no build lead times; intertie conflicts and asymmetry; no curtailment or timeslice data.
A future set may set policy_grade=true only after all required blocks are sourced and every structural gap is closed.
